text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Sending an outgoing domestic wire from a personal (Retail) account costs $25.00 per wire, under the Wire Transfer Policy (Rev 2026-02). The fee is debited from your funding account when the wire is sent and isn't refunded if the receiving bank returns the wire. (For comparison: outgoing international wires are $45.00 plus any intermediary/beneficiary bank charges, and incoming wires are $15.00.) The Retail Schedule of Fees and Charges (2026) simply refers wire fees to that policy.","cited_chunk_ids":["wire_transfer_policy::layout::B_structure::0005","wire_transfer_policy::layout::B_structure::0001","fee_schedule_2026::layout::B_structure::0001"],"reason":"The Wire Transfer Policy states the retail outgoing domestic wire fee and its scope covers retail checking accounts."}
